reviews.title: Please make a dark mode version of the app.
reviews.text:
I love this app, it has helped me immensely! 

I do have two suggestions though 

1) Can you make a dark mode version of the app?


2) I think it would be cool if you had a toggle under settings (where you’d have to take like 3-4 steps to access it) that turned off your ability to adjust the app intentions, or like only allow one change per day/week/set amount of time. Or make it where you can only lower the number of opens not raise them for a set period of time. 

The binge cycle still happens from time to time, and I think that one of these adjustments would help mitigate that some (obviously like any addict we will still find a loophole, but I think this might be helpful).

Save yourself the trouble, Apple has screen limit options for free. No need to waste $60 on this app or supporting these boys. 

And it is truly a shame because I wanted to support the boys who created this, but I will be sure to spread the word that the claims in this app are false and you will be overcharged and there’s nothing you can do about it. 

If for some reason they reach out to make it right, I will be sure to edit my review and make a new one as well.

I’ve been using it for about a week. It’s works really well and is motivating to follow through. I’ve already shorted my App intentions. I am liking this app much more than competitors. 

2 enhancements I’d love to see is time options for when an app is about to close bc you’ve reached the limit. 30 seconds is a little frustrating and I find myself just opening another session. A 2 minute warning would be nice. 
The next one is history or prior days.
Its syncs to screen time and that history is stored it’d be nice to see it all in BePresent. I’d like to look back over the last week to see how I did rather than just the streak counter.

reviews.title: Very effective
reviews.text: This is different than the screentime features Apple iPhones provides. Way more controls to tailor your your needs - like “Beast Mode” - which does NOT allow you to override (which is allowed with Apple Screentime). Features like Beast Mode force you to commit if you are serious. You can also cherrypick the apps you want to put schedules on, go cold turkey on, etc. I appreciate these guys for trying to keep us off these life sucking, draining mechanisms Big Tech could care less about. Fight the system and stay present!!

reviews.title: You’ll be surprised. (Note to PMs included)
reviews.text:
There’s a reason why this app works better than your iOS screen time app and honestly I’m not sure why. Maybe it’s allows sessions so if you blocked the morning off that becomes a routine vs screen time just cuts you off after a certain amount of time on any particular app and that sucks? I dunno. 

I’m not going to act like this idea hasn’t been thought of so I’m going to assume it hasn’t. Product Mgrs at be present I’m talking to you: After a user completes their present session, there should be a pop up timer that always displays when any of the designated apps are open. That is another visual trigger that I could almost damn near guarantee that would prevent users from doom scrolling. The disappointment in oneself comes after looking at the screen time data so why not display that in real time?
